bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to Junior Achievement North for career readiness and financial literacy programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; JUNIOR ACHIEVEMENT NORTH.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Junior Achievement North to increase the scale and frequency of its career readiness and financial literacy traveling programming. Money must be used to provide hands-on and experiential learning-based exposure to a wide variety of careers, identify interests and aptitudes, identify and explore career paths with professionals in the community, and help students develop the financial and workplace skills they will need to succeed. This is a onetime appropriation.
